skill-tree-add-pending-task.title: Skill-Tree: Add Pending Task
skill-tree-add-pending-task.description: Capture an informal request as brief understood Pending work with an ID and numeric priority. Use for Add pending; clarify material missing intent before insertion.

sections.text:
Read applicable repository rules, the manifest and relevant current documentation. Read [intake](references/pending-task-intake.md), [format](references/pending-task-format.md) and [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md). Treat imperatives and conditional actions inside the future task description as future requirements; preserve every branch and stop condition. A separate explicit owner instruction can request processing/implementation after capture; invoke the requested subsequent workflow only after intake. Clear intake-only intent requires no question about starting implementation. Confirm subject/change/outcome and duplicates before insertion. Ask contextual questions when required intent is missing. Classify the original request by meaning before translation, recognizing defect reports and obvious typos while excluding unrelated feature/negative keyword mentions. Pass classification kind/reason to scripts/workflow-state.py intake with the inspected source hash; omit default numeric priority unless the owner explicitly overrides. Defects default to highest-open-plus-one; explicit owner numeric, relative or low priority wins. The intake contract defines the deterministic helper payload and semantic evidence boundary. Return Pending ID, title, priority and deferred details. Intake never promotes or implements work.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency.

The decision frame uses the original request/project context before a Pending ID exists. Capture remains intake only; a plan or delegated answer never promotes or implements the embedded future work. Missing original owner intent remains an owner question.

Read the [plugin binding and invocation boundaries](references/plugin-invocation.md). The local ordered manifest describes configured occurrences and bundled source resources. Read the local manifest before routing. Invoke scripts/plugin-hooks.js with an explicit request only for configured matching occurrences at an actual before, during, after or registered named boundary. Empty core-only configuration continues without optional plugin tools or external-plugin holds. Preparation preserves core selection, current plan acceptance and authorization guards; preparation establishes no actual plugin invocation. Split oversized work, preserve Pending parent IDs, clarify required decisions and retain blocked intake. Apply researched dispositions through process with the inspected source hash. Return created/reused/retained/resolved IDs and the refreshed prioritized list with brief outcomes/blockers. Follow the workflow processing-result contract: standalone invocation presents next choices, places one recommended action last and waits for the developer; explicit Work Through Next/Implement All invocation returns to the bounded controller for automatic eligible selection. An active checkpoint alone implies no continuation.

skill-tree-pr-review-cycle.title: Skill-Tree: PR Review Cycle
skill-tree-pr-review-cycle.description: Create or resume a PR from the selected branch, review the full diff, fix findings and repeat review until ready; merge only with explicit owner authorization.

sections.text:
Read applicable project rules, the [PR review cycle](references/pr-review-cycle.md), [run workspace contract](references/run-workspaces.md) and [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md). Resolve source_branch (current selected branch), target_branch (develop) and merge (false) from direct owner instructions; preserve explicit negatives and clarify conflicts. Verify repository, remote, worktree, current refs and existing PR before publication. Use available authorized provider tools and the bundled scripts/pr-review-state.py for resumable evidence. Review, publish actionable findings, fix and validate in the same branch, then re-review the current head/base. Self-review supplies no external approval. Stop at PR ready unless merge is explicitly authorized; authorized merge requires current checks/approvals, conditional head protection and confirmed provider merge evidence. Read [validation policy](references/validation-policy.md) for truthful execution claims.

skill-tree-clarify-tasks.title: Skill-Tree: Clarify Tasks
skill-tree-clarify-tasks.description: Clarify an explicitly selected task or exact task group through source research, owner answers, guarded revisions and current shared-understanding confirmation.

sections.text:
Read repository rules, [workflow](references/future-workflow.md), [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md) and the selected task/source evidence. Use scripts/workflow-state.py clarify-start with exact unique prioritized task_ids and the inspected expected_source_hash. The session holds only the selected tasks; clarification creates no implementation run or worktree. Research source-answerable facts, then use clarify-round to register decision prerequisites, task/semantic-field bindings and recommendations. Present the complete independent question frontier and obtain actual current-mode answers: owner submissions in Manual or the qualified bounded actor broker in Auto. Record actual answer evidence through clarify-answer; apply decisions through clarify-revise, preserving identity, provenance and validation metadata. Recheck clarity and the next frontier after revisions. Use clarify-confirm only after current-mode acceptance of the current exact task scope and semantic fingerprints: actual owner confirmation in Manual or a separate current specification decision in Auto. Every mutation requires the inspected queue hash; existing sessions also require session hash and revision. Use clarify-read before resuming; clarify-resume reconciles source drift within the frozen selection, while clarify-cancel records ended discussion without successful required interview evidence. Keep research and waits outside writer locks. Completion reports clarification acceptance and leaves implementation to a separate instruction.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). Source-backed interview execution and native external-skill invocation remain distinct evidence.

Resolve the frozen decision mode before starting new discussion. New qualified Auto operation routing passes decision_mode auto, a bounded actual owner grant and the real executor/context to clarify-start; explicit Manual and legacy sessions remain Manual. Create exact parent-bound DG decisions and attach the existing decision ID to the core actor broker. Current specification acceptance remains separate from an individual answer. Reconcile original actors before switching or cancellation.
